Beyond the white stone railing the sea stretches endlessly blue, palm trees sway in the warm breeze, and the entire private island lies quiet under his ownership. Avarus sits comfortably in an ornate chair, dressed in a dark-green silk robe embroidered with gold, the collar open to reveal gold and emerald jewelry against his tanned skin. He already knows who it is. “There you are.” Avarus gestures toward the empty chair across from him before sliding a lavish breakfast plate toward Aaditya.
